title: Vietnam’s Leader Declares US Trade Deal Close
summary: Vietnam’s top leader To Lam tells Bloomberg the nation is “very close” to a trade deal with the US. Vietnam wants to import more US items, Lam says in an exclusive interview on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Paramount settles lawsuits, allowing for Warner Bros. deal
summary: Paramount Skydance has settled lawsuits brought by 12 state attorneys general and the Writers Guild trade union, a move that will allow the company to close its historic $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. Erik Larson reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Asian Stocks to Gain on Tech Optimism, Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks were poised to climb after a tech-fueled rally on Wall Street and a drop in oil prices amid hopes for diplomatic progress in the Iran war.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 22
summary: Oil steadied — after losing more than 9% over the previous four days — as Middle East supply concerns eased and traders tracked an apparent uptick in efforts to end the US-Iran war.

title: Ecuador Asks US Daily to Help Curb $30 Billion Cocaine Trade
summary: Ecuador asks the US ‘every day’ for more help fighting a cocaine trade worth an estimated $30 billion a year, President Daniel Noboa said Monday, while insisting local security forces should remain in charge.
